# LLM-based speech recognition and translation

[← Model index](../README.md#models)

**Reviewed as of 2026-09-12 · 28 entries.**

Recognition and translation models with a documented language-model connection. Conventional ASR systems and standalone encoders are outside this section's scope.

**Modalities:** T = text, I = image, V = video, A = general audio, S = speech, M = music, X = other structured modalities. A is a broad label, not a guarantee of every audio task. See the [methodology](../docs/methodology.md) for interaction labels, variant scope and inclusion rules.

Dates below refer to the linked paper or announcement, **not necessarily a weights/API release**. An em dash means no date was established from the reviewed source.

## Model notes

<a id="canary-qwen"></a>

### Canary-Qwen

Speech-augmented LLM for English transcription; conventional Canary checkpoints are separate models.

**Listed variants:** 2.5B.

<a id="fireredasr-llm"></a>

### FireRedASR-LLM

Only the LLM branch is counted; FireRedASR-AED is a different architecture.

**Listed variants:** FireRedASR-LLM.

<a id="fireredasr2-llm"></a>

### FireRedASR2-LLM

The LLM component of FireRedASR2S; VAD, punctuation and AED modules are not separate SpeechLM entries.

**Listed variants:** FireRedASR2-LLM.

<a id="fun-asr"></a>

### Fun-ASR

Speech transcription model; distinct from Fun-Audio-Chat.

<a id="gemini-3-5-transcribe"></a>

### Gemini 3.5 Transcribe

Unary and streaming interfaces; word timestamps and speaker information are structured textual outputs.

**Listed variants:** gemini-3.5-transcribe; gemini-3.5-transcribe-live.

<a id="glm-asr-nano"></a>

### GLM-ASR-Nano

GLM audio-to-text release; not GLM-4-Voice.

**Listed variants:** GLM-ASR-Nano-2512.

<a id="gpt-4o-mini-transcribe"></a>

### GPT-4o Mini Transcribe

Smaller speech-to-text model; API snapshot identifiers are not separate catalog entries.

**Listed variants:** gpt-4o-mini-transcribe.

<a id="gpt-4o-transcribe"></a>

### GPT-4o Transcribe

Transcription model with text prompting and audio input.

**Listed variants:** gpt-4o-transcribe.

<a id="gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize"></a>

### GPT-4o Transcribe Diarize

Generates transcripts associated with speakers through the Transcription API.

**Listed variants:** gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize.

<a id="gpt-live-transcribe"></a>

### GPT-Live-Transcribe

Generates transcripts incrementally from live audio.

**Listed variants:** gpt-live-transcribe.

<a id="gpt-transcribe"></a>

### GPT-Transcribe

Handles recorded audio and committed speech turns; separate from continuous live transcription.

**Listed variants:** gpt-transcribe.

<a id="granite-speech-3-3"></a>

### Granite Speech 3.3

Speech recognition and translation preserve a separate text-only mode of the base LLM.

**Listed variants:** 2B; 8B.

<a id="granite-speech-4-0"></a>

### Granite Speech 4.0

Compact multilingual recognition and speech-to-text translation.

**Listed variants:** granite-4.0-1b-speech.

<a id="granite-speech-4-1"></a>

### Granite Speech 4.1

Base prioritizes transcription/translation; Plus adds rich speaker/timing outputs and NAR changes decoding architecture.

**Listed variants:** 2B; 2B Plus; 2B NAR.

<a id="kyutai-stt-dsm"></a>

### Kyutai STT (DSM)

Streaming speech recognition with word timestamps; the smaller model also supports semantic voice activity detection.

**Listed variants:** stt-1b-en_fr; stt-2.6b-en.

<a id="llama-avsr"></a>

### Llama-AVSR

Uses lip movement and speech for robust transcription.

<a id="llama-mtsk"></a>

### Llama-MTSK

Adjusts the audio-visual token budget for speech recognition.

<a id="mimo-v2-5-asr"></a>

### MiMo-V2.5-ASR

Specialized transcription model, distinct from the general MiMo-V2.5 omni model.

<a id="mms-llama"></a>

### MMS-LLaMA

Compresses audiovisual speech into a small number of language-model tokens.

<a id="mome"></a>

### MoME

Sparse experts support audio-visual recognition at different token granularities.

<a id="omni-avsr"></a>

### Omni-AVSR

One LLM-based system for audio, visual and audiovisual speech recognition.

<a id="qwen3-asr"></a>

### Qwen3-ASR

Recognition models are counted; the separate forced aligner is not.

**Listed variants:** 0.6B; 1.7B.

<a id="seed-asr"></a>

### Seed-ASR

Context-aware speech recognition using continuous speech representations.

<a id="speech-llama"></a>

### Speech-LLaMA

Integrates acoustic representations into a text language model for recognition and translation.

<a id="vibevoice-asr"></a>

### VibeVoice-ASR

Generates transcription, speaker labels and timestamps together. The BitNet variant compresses the same model for edge CPUs.

**Listed variants:** VibeVoice-ASR; VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet.

<a id="vibevoice-asr-streaming"></a>

### VibeVoice-ASR-Streaming

Produces incremental transcription with speaker attribution.

<a id="voxtral-mini-transcribe-v2"></a>

### Voxtral Mini Transcribe V2

Batch transcription with diarization and timestamps; not the Voxtral audio-chat checkpoint.

**Listed variants:** Mini Transcribe V2.

<a id="voxtral-realtime"></a>

### Voxtral Realtime

Processes incoming audio incrementally for transcription.

**Listed variants:** Voxtral Realtime.
